import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset with features on different scales
data = {
    'height_cm': [160, 170, 175, 180, 190],
    'weight_kg': [55, 65, 70, 80, 95],
    'age': [22, 30, 35, 42, 50]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate mean and standard deviation for each column
means = df.mean()
stds = df.std()

# Implement z-score formula: (x - mean) / std
df_z_score = (df - means) / stds

# Verify standardized data has mean ~0 and std ~1
print("Means after standardization:")
print(df_z_score.mean().round(10))
print("\nStd deviations after standardization:")
print(df_z_score.std().round(10))

# Print original and standardized dataframes
print("\nOriginal Data:")
print(df)
print("\nZ-Score Standardized Data:")
print(df_z_score)
